mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and trigger negative equity returns over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen by more than 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals an imminent economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined and UNRATE has risen in the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand and potential economic deceleration, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has declined by more than 0.5% in 1 month during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has been trending upward over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals rising inflation pressures, which typically prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a growing labor force without sufficient job creation, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased and UNRATE has risen in the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% indicates an economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% in the latest quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is below 2.0% during late-cycle expansions.
